# BAK-002: Backup tools present

- **Group:** Backups
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

restic, borg, borgmatic, kopia and rclone configs or binaries are a sign host level backups exist. Their configs often hold repository passwords and cloud credentials, so stackward records only that they exist. A backup nobody has restored is a hope, not a backup.

## Verify by hand

```sh
command -v restic borg borgmatic kopia rclone; ls -l /etc/borgmatic* /etc/restic ~/.config/rclone
```

## How to fix it

Run a restore test into a scratch folder and write down how long it took.

Run `stackward explain BAK-002` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
